يكتمنوا (form VIII)
# يَكْتَمِنُوا (yaktaminū) /jak.ta.mi.nuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَمَنَ (iktamana)
# يُكْتَمَنُوا (yuktamanū) /juk.ta.ma.nuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِكْتَمَنَ (iktamana)
